source.author: Raven

quote: This is what I was trying to restore: Mantle of Dark Devotion 1 Dawn Crystal
notes: First-person author reports disenchanting one Mantle of Dark Devotion on May 15 then the restoration form listed a cost of 1 Dawn Crystal. This is restoration UI *cost*, not independently verified actual disenchant output or quantity. Quality rank, precise item-level/bonus, completed event log, character skill, specialization and build all unknown. Do not use as measured gold-EV/denominator. Contradicts the base-item WoWDB cannot-disenchant flag recorded separately.
